== Tables ==
{| class="wikitable"
|+ A plain wikitable
! Header A !! Header B !! Header C
|-
| Cell 1 || Cell 2 || [[Goober|Link cell]]
|-
| colspan="2" | Spanning cell || Cell 3
|}

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Name !! Score !! Date
|-
| Alice || 12 || 2026-01-02
|-
| Bob || 7 || 2025-12-30
|-
| Carol || 31 || 2026-03-14
|}

{| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"
|+ Collapsible table (starts collapsed)
! Key !! Value
|-
| One || 1
|-
| Two || 2
|}

{| class="wikitable"
|+ Inline light backgrounds, as commonly pasted from Wikipedia
! style="background:#eaecf0" | Light header !! style="background:#ccf" | Lavender header
|-
| style="background:#fff" | White cell with inherited text colour || style="background:#ffdead" | Navajo white cell
|-
| style="background:#dfd" | Light green || style="background:#fdd; color:#900" | Light red with own colour
|}

{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; table-layout:auto"
! A very long heading that keeps going !! Second !! Third !! Fourth !! Fifth !! Sixth !! Seventh !! Eighth !! Ninth !! Tenth
|-
| Some content that is intentionally verbose to stress column layout || b || c || d || e || f || g || h || i || j
|}
